
```{r}
library(e1071)
library(readxl)

# Assuming your Excel file is in the current working directory and named 'diabetes-hw4.xls'
data <- read_excel("diabetes-hw4.xls")

data$Outcome <- as.factor(ifelse(data$Outcome == "YES", 1, -1))

# Extracting features and outcomes
features <- data[, -ncol(data)] # assuming the last column is the outcome
outcome <- data$Outcome

# Train the SVM model
svm_model <- svm(outcome ~ ., data = data, type = 'C-classification', kernel = 'linear', scale = FALSE)

?svm()
# Print the model summary
print(svm_model)

svm_model$coefs

svm_model$rho
```
